title: 真假金丝雀的博弈第13章
content_zh:
第13章 酒局

    周五晚上七点，顾西辞的车停在公寓楼下。

    我拉开车门坐进副驾驶，他递过来一个文件袋。不是上次那种黑色封面的厚档案，这次很薄，里面只有两张纸。

    “方总那边出了点问题。”

    我打开文件袋。第一张是方总发来的邮件打印件，措辞很客气，但意思很明确——并购案的签约时间可能要往后推。原因写的是“内部尽调流程延长”。第二张是顾西辞助理整理的背景资料，只有一行字：方总近期与许向平有过一次私人饭局。

    “许向平不是签了协议吗？”

    “协议是协议，饭局是饭局。他签了退出并购案的协议，但没签不跟方总吃饭的协议。”顾西辞发动车子，单手打方向盘拐上主路，“方总这个人你应该还有印象，上次在会议室里被你一句话堵回去的那个。”

    “我记得。沪市口音，戴无框眼镜，最怕的是非财务风险。”

    “对。他怕非财务风险，所以许向平请他吃饭的时候特意聊的就是非财务风险——顾氏内部不稳定，我这个总裁位置坐不坐得住，项目团队里有没有隐患。全是没法用数据反驳的软刀子。”

    “方总信了？”

    “半信半疑。所以他没说不签，只说往后推。他想观察一段时间，看看顾氏内部到底稳不稳。”顾西辞把车拐进一条我陌生的路，两边是挂了灯笼的仿古建筑，应该是某个私房菜馆聚集区，“今晚我约了方总吃饭。你跟我一起去。”

    “又是吃饭。上次是茶会，这次是饭局，下次是不是要泡温泉？”

    “温泉暂时没有。但今晚这顿饭不好吃。”他停好车，转头看我，“方总带了两个人，一个是他助理，另一个是许向平那边的人。我不知道那个人的名字，但消息说他跟许向平走得很近。今晚的饭局说白了就是方总给我们和许向平那边的人同时摆了一桌，让你们当面过招。”

    “许向平本人不来？”

    “他不来。他来就太明显了。他派个人来，既能在方总面前继续吹风，又能避开跟我的正面冲突。”

    我解开安全带，没有急着下车。

    “那我今晚的角色是什么？”

    “我的女伴。但不是花瓶。方总上次在会议室里对你的印象很深，他信你的分析能力。如果许向平的人今晚继续在非财务风险上做文章，你来接招。法务和财务的问题我来答，风险评估和商业情报你来。”

    “收到。”

    私房菜馆藏在一条巷子深处，门面很小，进去之后别有洞天。包厢是中式装修，黄花梨的圆桌，墙上挂着水墨画，角落里点着一炉沉香。方总已经到了，坐在主位上。他左边坐着他的助理，右边坐着一个我从未见过的男人，四十岁出头，戴金丝眼镜，穿着深蓝色三件套西装，头发梳得一丝不苟。他面前放着一杯白茶，水面平静得像一面镜子。

    “顾总，温顾问，欢迎欢迎。”方总站起来握手，态度比上次在会议室里热络了一些，但眼神里还是带着一点审视，“这位是郑其明郑总，万盛集团的战略顾问。”

    郑其明站起来，朝我伸出手。他的手很软，握法是很轻的三根手指碰一下就松开。那种握法我太熟悉了，不是礼貌，是轻视。

    “温小姐，久仰大名。热搜上见过。”

    “郑总客气。我没什么大名，就是帮顾总跑腿的。”

    “跑腿能跑出让许总退并购案的协议，这腿跑得不简单。”他推了推眼镜，镜片反了一下头顶的灯光，看不清眼睛。

    坐下之后服务员开始上菜。冷盘四样，热菜一道道往上端。方总显然下了本钱，桌上摆着清蒸东星斑和鲍鱼红烧肉。但没有人动筷子。所有人的注意力都在空气里，不在盘子里。

    方总端起酒杯：“顾总，今天请你来，主要是想聊聊项目推进的事。邮件你看了，我们内部的尽调流程延长了。这跟顾氏本身没关系，主要是我们这边的合规部门比较谨慎。”

    “方总，谨慎是好事。但尽调流程延长的原因，我还是想听您直说。”顾西辞端起酒杯回敬，语气很温和，但每一个字都不含糊。

    方总放下酒杯，目光在郑其明身上扫了一下。这个小动作被我看得清清楚楚。

    “其实也没什么特别的。就是最近市场上有些声音，说顾氏内部正在调整，管理层可能有变动。我们作为合作方，当然希望项目的主导团队能保持稳定。”

    “管理层变动？方总，顾氏的管理层没有变动。我在这个位置上至少还能坐很久。”顾西辞说这句话的时候语气很轻松，甚至带着点开玩笑的意味。

    “那可不一定。”郑其明把筷子放下，“顾氏近几个月的舆论风波不少。真假千金的事在热搜上挂了三天，对股价的影响有目共睹。再加上你和温小姐的合约关系被媒体反复炒作，这些因素加在一起，很难说不会影响顾氏在合作方眼里的稳定性。”

    来了。我等的就是他开口。

    “郑总，”我端起茶杯，没喝酒，“您提到的舆论风波，我倒是有一些数据可以分享。真假千金事件上热搜的那三天，顾氏股价确实跌了两个点。但三天之后就反弹了，五天之内回到原位。至于合约关系被媒体炒作的事，方总上次在会议室里已经当面问过我，我也做了解释。方总，您还记得我当时是怎么说的吗？”

Chapter 13 Wine Bureau
At seven o'clock on Friday night, Gu Xici's car was parked downstairs in the apartment.
I opened the door and got in the passenger seat, and he handed me a document bag. It's not a thick file with a black cover like last time. This time it's very thin, with only two pieces of paper inside.
"There's something wrong with Mr. Fang."
I opened the file bag. The first one is a printout of the email sent by Mr. Fang. The wording is very polite, but the meaning is very clear - the signing date of the merger and acquisition case may have to be postponed. The reason is written as "extension of the internal due diligence process." The second picture is the background information compiled by Gu Xici's assistant, with only one line: Mr. Fang recently had a private dinner with Xu Xiangping.
"Didn't Xu Xiangping sign the agreement?"
"The agreement is an agreement, and the dinner is a dinner. He signed an agreement to withdraw from the merger and acquisition project, but he did not sign an agreement not to have dinner with Mr. Fang." Gu Xici started the car, turned the steering wheel with one hand and turned onto the main road, "You should still remember Mr. Fang, the one who was blocked by you in the conference room last time."
"I remember. He has a Shanghainese accent, wears rimless glasses, and is most afraid of non-financial risks."
"Yes. He is afraid of non-financial risks, so when Xu Xiangping invited him to dinner, he specifically talked about non-financial risks - Gu's internal instability, whether I can hold my position as president, and whether there are any hidden dangers in the project team. They are all soft knives that cannot be refuted with data."
"Mr. Fang believed it?"
"Dubious. So he didn't say not to sign, only to push it back. He wanted to observe for a while to see if the Gu family was internally stable." Gu Xici turned the car onto a road that was unfamiliar to me. There were antique buildings with lanterns on both sides. It should be a gathering area for private restaurants. "I have an appointment with Mr. Fang for dinner tonight. You go with me."
"It's time to eat again. Last time it was a tea party, this time it's a dinner party. Are we going to take a hot spring bath next time?"
"There are no hot springs available at the moment. But tonight's meal is not delicious." He parked the car and turned to look at me. "Mr. Fang brought two people, one is his assistant, and the other is from Xu Xiangping's side. I don't know the name of that person, but the news is that he is very close to Xu Xiangping. To put it bluntly, for tonight's dinner, Mr. Fang set a table for us and Xu Xiangping's side at the same time, so that you can fight in person."
"Xu Xiangping himself won't come?"
"He won't come. It would be too obvious if he comes. By sending someone here, he can continue to brag in front of Mr. Fang and avoid a direct conflict with me."
I unbuckled my seat belt and didn't rush out of the car.
"So what's my role tonight?"
"My female companion. But not a vase. Mr. Fang was very impressed with you in the conference room last time. He believes in your analytical skills. If Xu Xiangping's people continue to make a fuss about non-financial risks tonight, you will take over. I will answer the legal and financial questions, and you will do the risk assessment and business intelligence."
"receive."
The private restaurant is hidden deep in an alley, with a small facade. Once you enter, you will find yourself in a different world. The private room is decorated in Chinese style, with a huanghuali round table, ink paintings hanging on the wall, and a burner of agarwood burning in the corner. Mr. Fang has arrived and is sitting in the main seat. On his left sat his assistant, and on his right sat a man I had never seen before. He was in his early forties, wearing gold-rimmed glasses, a dark blue three-piece suit, and his hair was meticulously combed. There was a cup of white tea in front of him, and the water was as calm as a mirror.
"Mr. Gu, Consultant Wen, welcome." Mr. Fang stood up and shook hands. His attitude was a little warmer than last time in the conference room, but his eyes still looked a little scrutinized. "This is Mr. Zheng Qiming, the strategic consultant of Wansheng Group."
Zheng Qiming stood up and stretched out his hand towards me. His hands are very soft, and his grip is very light, with three fingers touching it and releasing it. I'm all too familiar with that kind of grip. It's not polite, it's contemptuous.
"Miss Wen, I have long admired her name. I have seen her on trending searches."
"Mr. Zheng, you're welcome. I don't have a famous name. I just run errands for Mr. Gu."
"The errand was able to get Mr. Xu to withdraw from the merger and acquisition agreement. This errand was not easy." He pushed up his glasses, and the lenses reflected the light above his head, making it difficult to see clearly.
After sitting down, the waiter started serving the food. Four kinds of cold dishes were served, and hot dishes were served one after another. Mr. Fang has obviously invested a lot of money. On the table are steamed Eastern Star Spots and Braised Abalone Pork. But no one moved their chopsticks. All attention is on the air, not on the plate.
Mr. Fang raised his glass: "Mr. Gu, I invited you here today mainly because I want to talk about project advancement. You have read the email. Our internal due diligence process has been extended. This has nothing to do with Gu itself. It is mainly because our compliance department is more cautious."
"Mr. Fang, it's good to be cautious. But I still want to hear your honest explanation of the reason for the extension of the due diligence process." Gu Xici raised his glass and responded with a gentle tone, but every word was unambiguous.
Mr. Fang put down his wine glass and glanced at Zheng Qiming. I could see this little action clearly.
"Actually, it's nothing special. It's just that there have been some voices in the market recently that Gu's is undergoing internal adjustments and there may be changes in management. As a partner, of course we hope that the project's leading team can remain stable."
"Management change? Mr. Fang, Gu's management has not changed. I can at least sit in this position for a long time." Gu Xici said this in a relaxed tone, even with a hint of joking.
"That's not necessarily true." Zheng Qiming put down his chopsticks. "The Gu family has been in a lot of public opinion troubles in recent months. The matter of the real and fake daughter has been on the hot search for three days, and the impact on the stock price is obvious to all. In addition, the contractual relationship between you and Miss Wen has been repeatedly hyped by the media. Together, these factors, it is difficult to say that it will not affect the stability of the Gu family in the eyes of partners."
Coming. I was waiting for him to speak.
"Mr. Zheng," I picked up the tea cup without drinking, "I have some data to share about the public opinion storm you mentioned. In the three days when the real and fake daughter incident was a hot topic, Gu's stock price did fall by two points. But it rebounded three days later and returned to its original position within five days. As for the fact that the contractual relationship was hyped by the media, President Fang asked me in person in the conference room last time, and I also explained it. President Fang, do you still remember what I said then?"
title_en: The Game of True and False Canaries Chapter 13
